name: Samuel Jose
title: Security-Focused Engineer
objective: Security-focused engineer with experience in system hardening, vulnerability assessment, API development, and cloud-based data workflows. Background includes securing distributed systems, supporting zero-trust environments, and building Python-driven data and automation solutions. Strong in translating technical findings into actionable improvements across security and operational teams.

bullets: Led system hardening efforts to mitigate social engineering and network-based threats.
Conducted vulnerability assessments on network ports and system configurations.
Managed secure alert routing, remote access control systems, and zero-trust operational workflows.
Maintained audit-ready logging and security monitoring through Avigilon systems.
Directed secure data migration from CSV sources to relational databases, improving data integrity and accessibility.
Operated ticketing systems to triage, track, and resolve security and system issues.
Built Python-based machine learning models (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit Learn) for cost estimation.
Developed REST and SOAR API integrations in Azure and Power Apps to automate data pipelines.
Delivered data visualization and workflow improvements using Microsoft ecosystem tools.
Presented technical solutions and documentation to engineering leadership.
